entries.title: A task on another of your computers can move to another model
entries.body: A started task that runs on another of your computers can now move to another model in place, among the subscriptions that computer is signed in to. The sign-in card's Move works for such a task, and your first mate can move a task stuck at its provider there, as it already could on this Mac. The task keeps its key, branch and working copy on that computer.
entries.noPicture: The sign-in card and its Move button look the same as they already do for a task on this Mac; only the tasks they appear for changed.
